neg: Close to €60k list — M135 and S3 money
Barely faster than the Mk8 above 200 km/h
partsNote: Volkswagen dealers and independent garages everywhere; most parts next-day.
pos: Updated infotainment with physical wheel buttons
Torque-vectoring rear axle with Special and Drift modes
relNote: Proven drivetrain; too new for TÜV data.
wowNote: A knowing nod from enthusiasts; otherwise a sleeper.

neg: 190 km/h limit and range drops fast at Autobahn speed
52 kWh battery: about 431 km WLTP, much less driven hard
Too heavy and too little battery cooling for sustained track use
note: Orders open since 07.10.2026, deliveries not yet announced (MY2027). Kerb weight is VW's preliminary EU figure (May 2026 factsheet). Real-world kWh/100 km, upkeep, insurance and tyre costs are estimates.
partsNote: Volkswagen dealer network everywhere; shares parts with the ID. Polo range.
pos: Compact, quick off the line and cheap to run in town
GTI performance for under €40k (€36,995 with VW bonus until year-end)
Front axle limited-slip differential for tight passes
relNote: MEB Entry platform shared with ID. Polo / Cupra Raval; too new for any reliability data.
wowNote: GTI badge and red trim get a knowing nod; otherwise a small hatch.
